name: Roasted Brussels Sprout, Kale & Apple Salad with Honey-Dijon Dressing

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.36 kg Brussels sprouts
3 lemons
3 bunches kale
3 Gala apples
1 small bunch green onions (scallions)

instructions.primary_message: Trim ends and halve Brussels sprouts. Place in a large bowl.

Add oil and salt to the bowl and toss to coat. Divide Brussels sprouts between two large baking sheet pans in a single layer and place in the oven. Roast, tossing once, until fork-tender, 25-30 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, juice lemons into the bowl used for the Brussels sprouts.
Peel and mince garlic, then add to the bowl with the lemon juice.
Add mayo, oil, Dijon, honey, salt, and pepper to the bowl and whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup mayonnaise
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
3 tbsp Dijon mustard
2 tbsp honey
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Fold kale leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems. Chop or tear leaves into bite-sized pieces and transfer to the bowl. Using your hands, massage the dressing into the kale.
Core and small dice apples, then add to the bowl.
Trim green onions; cut crosswise into ¼-inch pieces and add to the bowl.
When the Brussels sprouts are done, remove from oven and sprinkle with Parmesan. Set aside to cool slightly and allow cheese to melt, about 5 minutes.
Add cranberries, pumpkin seeds, and Brussels sprouts to the bowl and toss to combine the salad.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup dried cranberries
½ cup pumpkin seeds

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide salad between bowls and enjoy!
